prompt: Who is the most recent recipient of a Nobel Prize in one of the sciences who held Asian citizenship at the time of the award?
answer:
The most recent is **Kenso Soai of Japan**, who received the **2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry** jointly with Henri B. Kagan.

The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences announced the award on **October 7, 2026**, “for the discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis.” Soai held Japanese citizenship at the time of the award.
